title: Viola Davis Completes The EGOT Achievement After Winning A Grammy Over The Weekend
htmlContent:
Viola Davis is a name that has become synonymous with excellence in the entertainment industry. The talented actress has made a name for herself through her incredible performances on stage and screen, and now, she has added another feather to her already impressive cap.

Recently, Viola Davis made history by becoming the 23rd person to achieve the coveted EGOT (Emmy, Grammy, Oscar, and Tony) status. This achievement recognizes her outstanding work in all four areas of entertainment, making her one of the most accomplished artists of our time.

Viola Davis' journey to EGOT status started with her first Tony award in 2001 for her role in the play "King Hedley II." Over the years, she has continued to captivate audiences with her powerful performances on Broadway and in Hollywood. Her first Emmy came in 2015 for her role in the hit series "How to Get Away with Murder," and she went on to win her second Emmy in 2017 for her portrayal of former First Lady Michelle Obama in "Lackawanna Blues."

In 2016, Davis made history by becoming the first African American woman to win the Best Supporting Actress Oscar for her role in "Fences." This landmark achievement was a testament to her incredible talent and impact on the entertainment industry.

Most recently, Davis added the Grammy award to her EGOT collection, win for Sunday win for the audiobook of her memoir “Finding Me."

She won the award for "Best Audiobook, Narration, and Storytelling Recording," according to a tweet by the Recording Academy, which hosts the Grammys.

Viola Davis' EGOT achievement is a testament to her incredible talent and versatility as an artist. Her ability to excel in theater, television, film, and music is a testament to her hard work and dedication to her craft. It's an honor to see such a deserving and talented performer recognized for her outstanding work in all areas of entertainment.

In conclusion, Viola Davis' EGOT status is a significant milestone in her already impressive career. Her journey serves as inspiration for aspiring artists everywhere, reminding us that hard work and dedication can lead to amazing accomplishments. She continues to be a trailblazer and an inspiration to us all.
